captions.detailed: A professional camera speedlight flash featuring a matte black body, a mounting foot at the base, and a rear control panel with a small display screen. The main flash head is rectangular with a frosted light-emitting front panel and is mounted between two side yoke arms. The assembly is fully articulated, allowing the head to swivel horizontally on a vertical revolute joint at the top of the body, and pitch vertically on a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke arms.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a professional camera flash with a mounting foot, a tall rear control body, and a forward-facing flash head. The model should include a vertical revolute joint allowing the head assembly to swivel, and a horizontal revolute joint for the head to pitch, using matte black plastic for the body and a frosted white material for the flash diffuser.
captions.factory: Construct the base mount using a thin square box and a short cylindrical connector. Build the main vertical body from a filleted box, adding a dark grey rectangular panel and a white indicator line on its rear face to represent the control screen. Create the swivel yoke assembly using a central disc cylinder and two vertical rectangular arms. Model the rotating flash head from a rounded box, adding a thin white rectangular plate on the front face for the diffuser lens, and assemble the parts using revolute joints for horizontal pan and vertical tilt.
